pick.title: Choose what to fill in
pick.description: Pick the sections and the dates. We make a sheet with your students already listed.
pick.sectionsLimit: You can pick up to {{max}} sections at a time.

download.title: Download the sheet
download.failed: Could not make the sheet. Try again.
download.denied: You cannot fill in one of these sections on this day. Pick fewer sections or another date.
download.hint: Fill P for present, A for absent, L for late, LV for leave. Leave a cell empty to keep it as it is.

upload.title: Upload your filled sheet
upload.dropzone: Drop the sheet here, or choose a file
upload.fileTooLarge: This file is too large — choose a file under 5 MB.
upload.fileWrongType: This file type is not supported — choose an .xlsx or .csv file.

review.title: Review before saving
review.caption: Every row of the sheet — errors first
review.overwriteBannerHint: These students already have attendance for that day. Saving replaces it.
review.skipErrors: Save the correct rows and skip the rows with errors
review.skipErrorsHint: Rows with errors are left out. You can fix them in the sheet and upload again.
review.saveFailed: Could not save. Nothing was changed.
review.nothingToSave: There is nothing to change in this sheet.
review.earlierGone: The earlier upload was not found. This sheet will be saved as a new upload.

rowError.ROLL_NOT_IN_SECTION: This roll is not in {{section}} — check the roll.
rowError.SECTION_NOT_FOUND: This section was not found — check the section name.
rowError.NOT_ALLOWED_SECTION: You do not take attendance for this section.
rowError.DATE_OUTSIDE_YEAR: This date is outside the school year — check the date.
rowError.NON_WORKING_DAY: The school is closed on this date — pick a working day.
rowError.FUTURE_DATE: This date has not come yet — only today and past dates can be filled.
rowError.NEEDS_CORRECT_PERMISSION: You can only fill new days. To change a recorded day, ask an admin.
rowError.BAD_STATUS: This status is not understood — use P, A, L or LV, or leave it empty.
rowError.DUPLICATE_ROW: This student and date appear twice — keep one row.
rowError.NAME_MISMATCH: The name does not match this roll — check the roll.

expired.title: This review has expired
expired.message: A review only lasts a few minutes — upload the sheet again.

history.title: Uploaded sheets
history.description: Every attendance sheet saved by someone at your school.
history.emptyExplanation: When someone saves an attendance sheet, it shows up here.

detail.title: Upload on {{when}}
detail.changedLaterHint: This mark was changed after this upload.
detail.rollNotInSection: This roll is not in that section — check the roll.
detail.rowProblem: This row could not be used — check it in the sheet.

restart.title: Upload the sheet again
restart.stale: The register changed after you checked the sheet. Nothing was saved.
restart.failed: The sheet could not be saved. Nothing was changed.
restart.denied: You cannot save one of these days now. Nothing was saved.
